# Fighting Force Recharged 0.0.130

[![Support on Ko-fi](https://img.shields.io/badge/Support_on_Ko--fi-FF5E5B?style=for-the-badge&logo=kofi&logoColor=white)](https://ko-fi.com/utkiduck)

![Fighting Force Recharged 0.0.130 release poster](https://github.com/mbushuev/fighting-force-recharged/releases/download/v0.0.130/FightingForceRecharged-0.0.130-Poster.png)

The first public release of Fighting Force Recharged, an unofficial
compatibility and gameplay patch for the original Windows version of
**Fighting Force (1997)**.

## Highlights

- Widescreen gameplay with proportional menus, HUD and movies.
- Interpolated 60 FPS rendering with the original simulation cadence and game
  speed. Native 30 FPS rendering remains selectable.
- Free third-person orbit and an animated first-person view with visible arms,
  body and held items. Camera collision and camera-relative movement.
- Modern keyboard/mouse and Xbox/XInput controls, remappable actions,
  per-player device assignments and configurable controller vibration.
- Dynamic two-player split screen: share a camera while both players fit,
  then separate into independent views. Original shared framing is selectable.
- Three campaign slots, automatic level-entry saves, Continue, previous-level
  recovery and confirmed level restart.
- Optional player block for all four heroes with empty hands or light items.
  Enable **Options > Player Block**; hold **Q / LB** with default bindings.
  It is disabled by default.
- Corrected transparent cutouts and near-camera geometry, smoother loading
  transitions, focus recovery and original CD-audio playback.

## Install

1. Download and extract **FightingForceRecharged-0.0.130-Windows.zip**.
2. Run **FightingForceSetup.exe**.
3. Choose **Add fix to existing game folder** for a supported installation,
   or **Install game from original disc** for a new one.
4. Start **fforce.exe** from that game folder.

Requires **Windows 10/11 x64** and a supported **English PC retail or reviewed
English RIP** copy. The full retail version needs its original mounted disc.
The reviewed RIP runs from its own folder; its missing intro and music are not
reconstructed. Original audio media can supply music.

Supplied game executables, libraries and assets remain unchanged byte for byte.
The patch is a separate runtime DLL. No game files, disc images, movies or
music are included or downloaded by setup. Existing settings and saves are
preserved when applying the fix to an existing installation.

## Verification and limits

The release pipeline builds and tests the exact tagged source, audits package
contents and independently verifies downloaded archives. **SHA256SUMS.txt**
contains archive checksums; **release.json** records their hashes and the
source revision. **Source.zip** is the source package for development.

Free orbit, first person, dynamic split screen and interpolated rendering
remain experimental. Full-campaign geometry and extended two-controller play
need broader coverage. Saves restore level entry, not an arbitrary moment in
combat. The installer and wrapper are not code-signed.

See the [quick start](https://github.com/mbushuev/fighting-force-recharged/blob/v0.0.130/docs/QUICKSTART.md),
[tested media](https://github.com/mbushuev/fighting-force-recharged/blob/v0.0.130/docs/VALIDATION.md#tested-media-and-source)
and included documentation for supported files, controls and known limits.
